title: Unify Gallery clock and workload policy
scope: Use one fixed-step, catch-up, pause, background and device-profile admission policy across desktop and mobile shells.
acceptance: Equal action/time traces produce equal physics submissions across platform adapters within explicit catch-up limits.
Slow frames, pause, backgrounding and changing workload limits have deterministic tested behavior.
evidence: PASS: ctest --test-dir build-macos-metal-preview -R 'parallel-mater-(gallery-session-contract-tests|gallery-frame-policy-tests|ipad-session-tests|physics-frame-budget-tests|gallery-frame-timing-tests)$' --output-on-failure (5/5); Apple M4 Metal host; deterministic equal-trace, slow-frame, pause, background, modal, and profile-change coverage in tracked tests
PASS: cmake --build build-ipad-gallery --config Debug --target parallel-mater-ipad-gallery -j2; signed arm64 iPadOS Gallery app; shared frame policy and UIKit adapter compiled successfully
